description: United Kingdom: HM Land Registry Price Paid Data (open) and UPRN-based addressing; MLS does not exist: listing portals licence data individually.

parcel.note: Title numbers; UPRN (Unique Property Reference Number) is the stable property key where licensed from Ordnance Survey/Geoplace.

onboarding: Price Paid Data: Open Government Licence v3.0, attribution required
Address and UPRN data: licence from Ordnance Survey / GeoPlace (commercial)
Portal listing data (Rightmove, Zoopla): commercial agreement; automated extraction is generally prohibited
licence.attribution: Contains HM Land Registry data © Crown copyright and database right. Licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.

notes: Sale prices are registered with a lag of weeks: use the transfer date and expect recent months to be incomplete
Leasehold versus freehold is a primary property attribute
